svg.title: Flower Anatomy Drag & Drop
svg.desc: A fully static SVG learning interface for flower anatomy with simulated hint, check answer, and reset popups using internal SVG navigation links only.

g.text: Match each label tile to the correct flower part.
Static SVG simulation: use the buttons to reveal overlays and answers.
3. Match it to a dotted slot.
Because this is a no-JavaScript SVG,
the buttons open static learning states
Start with the large colorful structures.
Petals attract pollinators, while sepals protect the bud.
The male part is the stamen:
The female part is the pistil:
Look for shape clues: pollen sits on anthers, the stigma is at the top of the pistil, and the receptacle supports the flower.
Compare your matches with the completed labels below.
Tip: A complete answer should connect each tile to both its location and its function.
The activity has returned to the starting screen.
All label tiles remain in the word bank because this
is a static, no-script SVG learning simulation.
Use the diagram, arrows, hint panel, and answer key to practice matching.
